name: Necromancy (Vitreous Path) — 1 Basic — Hour of Death

system.description: Grants the necromancer his own Deathsight without needing a wraith's eyes. Spending a Mental Trait activates the sense for one scene or hour; the necromancer then makes a Static Mental Challenge at a Storyteller-set difficulty to learn how near a subject is to death, likely cause of death, and impressions of the subject's feelings on first meeting others. One Trait risked reveals death within weeks to a month; three Traits narrows it to days with cause impressions; five Traits pinpoints time of death within an hour and location within blocks. Only affects one target per use.
